text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's tag time! Here I go, Turbo full-speed 
daaaash!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You'll never catch me, Nature! Take 
thiiiis!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes, do as you please. As if you 
could maintain the lead at that pace 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I think it's good now. Wait, Turbo!

Twin Turbo runs and runs. Giving it her 
all to the very end, heedless of what 
comes next.

"Chasing behind is her humble classmate, 
Nice Nature. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *wheeze*~... This 
wasn't... supposed to happen~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nature, stay away~. No, no, nooo~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What a silly girl... If you run off like 
that, of course you're gonna run out of 
steam.

Twin Turbo ran ahead with no regard for 
the consequences— and got caught. It was 
only natural. And yet...

"What if they pull away so far that we 
can't catch them...?"
Yes... Just like "that day".

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... I can't... go on~. But...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll go as far as I can take it...! 
Turbo's... Turbo hasn't burned out 
yet~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
I won!! It was only by a nose at the very 
end, but I hung on to the finish line...!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahhh~, that was so much fun...!!

—On the day of that mock race. Twin Turbo 
went on a huge breakaway, savored the 
extreme thrill, and won.

She won't listen to what others say, but 
if the mood strikes, she goes all out 
until the end. That was the Front Runner 
Umamusume, Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo wants to challenge the 
Twinkle Series soon!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta show the whole world what this 
big-shot rookie is made of! Ahem, behold!

In truth... she doesn't draw much 
attention. Small in stature, few see her 
as a serious Classic contender. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants to run at full blast until I 
completely burn out! I'm gonna run and run 
and just keep on running!

I want to grant Twin Turbo's wish to 
'completely burn herself out with 
everything she has.' And then—

I wanted to show everyone Twin Turbo's 
thrilling and captivating runaway lead.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! As long as Turbo unleashes 
her full talent, I can beat everyone, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
To Nature too! And to that Tokai Teio, as 
well!

I couldn't help but hesitate to speak. 
Yes, Tokai Teio was—

She is universally recognized as top-tier 
among her peers. That talent is suited for 
the Classic Triple Crown, which means...

A rare talent rumored to be capable of 
winning all three—the Satsuki Sho, the 
Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho—and 
becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume.

The acceleration born from the suppleness 
of her limbs is extraordinary; an ordinary 
runner stands no chance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aiming higher than Tokai Teio, huh? As 
always, you declare your massive dreams 
without a single bit of hesitation~

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Turbo's gonna give it her all! 
Training time, training time right now!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, such an inimitable brilliance! And 
yet~...

And so, our journey toward the Make Debut 
began, but—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaah, no, no, noooo! Turbo can't run 
properly when I'm surrounded by a crowd!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu, I hate the gate... I'm just kinda 
not feeling like going in today...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm bored of training now, maybe 
I'll make a video or something.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
How about a video of Trainer battling 
Nature? Or maybe an ant vs. an antlion...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo always has amazing momentum at the 
start, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
He's super skittish, terrible with the 
gates, and on top of that, gets bored 
really easily...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. To get straight to the 
point...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Can we really get this girl ready for her 
debut? Doesn't it seem pretty tough?
choice_data_list: First off... we're starting from there...?

text_block_list.text:
"I hold my head in my hands. The appeal of 
her running is immense, but... even 
greater than that are the far too many and 
massive problems she carries..."

"First, how do we manage to get her to her 
debut? We have to somehow sneak past the 
very first hurdle that other Umamusume 
clear with ease..."
